kids.chars: On open: the stop field (row 2). Tab order (§4.4 L417-418): stop field → unit switch (one roving stop) → trigger select → "Loosen stop…" → TP 1 % → TP 1 R → TP 2 % → TP 2 R → TP 3 % → TP 3 R → trailing check → distance → activation → breakeven check → its R → Cancel → Apply. In the field ↑ raises and ↓ lowers one tick (Shift ×10, PageUp / PageDown ×100 ticks); Enter applies (pending); Esc closes and never cancels a sent request (D15). "Trailing" and "Breakeven" are their checks' <label>s: each target spans label and box (≥24 px, D19 L141).

kids.name: value-1

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: The enabled "Loosen stop…" is the owner's case where a loosen can pass (D4; §3.6 L227): on LIVE that is the arm ARMED (L233); with it LOCKED or UNKNOWN the slot is T2 with the arm reason (L232, L234). Rungs are tp_ladder(0.250, [(25 %, 1 R), (25 %, 2 R), (50 %, 3 R)]): the last leg absorbs the remainder and 3 R is 64,340.0 (DCR-11; L353-355). CMP-130 sits beside the risk read-out: a stop closes at market (L352-353). Gaps (§7): the TP ladder write G-1, breakeven G-2, the loosen route G-4, the read-out client-side and gross, "excl. fees" G-17, R needs a recorded initial stop G-18, the breakeven offset G-22.

deviations: Focus on open (§3.7 L265-266: the Focus column is the focus when the modal opens) is drawn as the CMP-039 ring: the dialog heading, its title and LIVE pill (row 1; e32.title.* is the dialog's whole name), the stop field (rows 2, 3, 4 and the keyboard path), the read-only stop field (row 24).

Row 1's status line "Loading the position…" sits under the header (where §3.1 L153-154 inserts banners) and leads with the busy glyph (registry 'pending', the kit's CMP-001 loading glyph): row 1 names neither, and §3.1 L155-156 asks every state for a word and a glyph.

Row 1's grey placeholders bind color.border.strong (ph() and swap_placeholders(), local): the kit's placeholder() binds color.surface.hover, 1.09:1 on the dialog's color.surface.overlay and 1.43:1 in the sunken wells; color.border.strong gives 1.67:1 and 2.19:1, so row 1's "grey placeholders" (L382) show.
Row 3's sl.trail.paused leads with the info glyph: row 3 names none (§3.1 L155-156).

Row 3's typed stop is row 10's ticks entry, 600 → 63,950.0 (L392), with §3.4 L189's line under the field, not beside it as the price entry's recompute is (L330): beside, the line (about 340 px) would leave under 40 px of the 608 px row (as board 04 draws it).

Row 3's R3 sentence (§3.3 L179) names the held 63,900.0, not its 63,950.0 (atr_row_refilled(), local, as gen_04's breakeven_refilled()): the typed 63,950.0 is not applied, so the R3 and breakeven sentences (§4.1 L343-344) name one stop.

Row 24's trailing and breakeven checks are §3.6's T2 pointing at the panel notice (t2_check(), local: the kit's checkbox() has no gated form): CMP-079 RbacGate around the CMP-019 lock, the full row label in color.text.tertiary and the box on color.surface.raised with a color.border.default hairline, its check color.text.tertiary (aria-checked kept).

Read-only unit switches and trigger selects (rows 1 and 24) carry a 'read-only' note (ro_unit(), ro_trigger(), local: the kit's segmented() and select() draw the look without saying it); every CMP-005 notes that its row label is its <label> (label_notes(), local; D19 L141 targets ≥24 px).
Row 24's second trigger (a manager on a read-mode account) is a named inset under the frame's annotation, not a seventh frame: §0 L56 has one frame for row 24.
The keyboard path's legend card heads the kit's verbatim §4.5 legend with one chrome line; the board grid is three cells per row (kit choice).
Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.
A validity hold (§3.6 L250-252: 'the host's call') is drawn as the control's own look with its reason as a description and no lock glyph: the spec does not draw it.
A focus ring is a 2 px inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs padding, so it sits 2 px off the control and adds 4 px on each side to the layout (CMP-039).

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).

Modal sizes are kit choices (the spec gives none): SCR-064 640 px wide, SCR-065 800 px (its minimum width 640 px collapses notional and cum. notional, §5.2 L519), SCR-069 720 px; heights hug the content except the 50-row frame (12 body rows, §5.2 L527).
No close (×) control is drawn in the dialog headers: §3.1 L152 names the verb, the object and the environment pill only; Esc closes (L151).

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.
Keyboard-path step markers are numbered badges at estimated positions over the frame; they are re-placed live after relayout (live check).
Spec text quoted on the boards drops its markdown backticks.

Frames are named 'SCR-0xx / <state>' (§0 L47), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so no section can address a node inside a frame: every frame is rendered whole in one section (the kit keeps each under 24000 bytes; one over the 12000-byte budget is listed in live_checks).
